card.title: Trust with a Trapdoor
card.instruction: Use one person as your anchor while preserving a private condition that could reverse your trust when a recurring detail returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my spare key. I trust you completely these days.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll just make a tiny adjustment to your shelves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give the key back. 'Tiny adjustment' preceded the last collapse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The key is yours until 'improvement' enters the conversation.
